theorem BootWf_nil : BootWf []

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_0 [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (c : CfgM) (HC : CfgStatic γ
    c) (id : w64) (HT : TrackedOk γ c id) (B : Int) (HB : B < 2 ^ 64) (s s' : PState) : StepC c id B
    s [] s' → ⊢ ⧖(B.toNat - γ.reBoot.length) -∗ £ 1 -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s ={⊤}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id
    s'

theorem alloc_evs [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (ids : GSet w64) : ⊢ |==> ∃ names, [∗map] x ↦ _u ∈ toMap
    ids, iprop(∃ γx, ⌜names !! x = some γx⌝ ∗ monoListAuthOwn γx 1 [])

theorem alloc_maps [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {K V : Type} [DecidableEq K] [Pos.Countable K]
    [Pos.Countable V] (ids : GSet w64) : ⊢ |==> ∃ names, ⌜names.domSet = ids⌝ ∗ [∗map] x ↦ _u ∈
    toMap ids, iprop(∃ γx, ⌜names !! x = some γx⌝ ∗ ghostMapAuth γx 1 ∅)

def initPState : PState :=
  { term := W64 0, vote := W64 0, lead := W64 0, role := Role.follower, votes := ∅, outbox := [],
    base := { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 }, log := [], commit := W64 0, matched := ∅ }

theorem ownRaftGhost_alloc_core [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (E : CoPset) (cfg ids : GSet w64) (dyn :
    Option ((e : GooseExts) → DynCfg)) (ccOk : w32 → List w8 → Prop) (L : List EntryM) (t : w64) (C
    : RaftNames → IProp GF) (trk : Option (GSet w64)) (Htrk : ∀ (T : GSet w64), trk = some T → cfg ⊆
    T ∧ dyn = none) (ns : Bool) (Hns : ns = true → L ≠ []) (nx : Bool) (Hnx : nx = true → L ≠ [])
    (sok : List BootEntry → List w8 → Prop) (sl : w64 → Option GName) (nsN certN : Namespace) : cfg
    ≠ ∅ → ¬W64 0 ∈ ids → BootWf L → (L ≠ [] → 1 ≤ uint.Z t) → ⊢ allocClientGen E cfg dyn ccOk L C
    nsN ={E}=∗ ∃ γ, ⌜γ.reCfg = cfg ∧ γ.reDyn = dyn ∧ γ.reCCOk = ccOk ∧ γ.reBoot = L ∧ γ.reTracked =
    trk ∧ γ.reNoSnap = ns ∧ γ.reNoXfer = nx ∧ γ.reSnapOkRaw = sok ∧ γ.reSnapLoc = sl ∧ γ.reNs = nsN
    ∧ γ.reCertNs = certN⌝ ∗ raftCommitInv γ ∗ isCommitted γ L ∗ ([∗map] id ↦ _u ∈ toMap ids,
    ownRaftGhost γ id (initPStateAt t L) dyn.isSome) ∗ C γ ∗ rdCred γ (2 ^ 64 - 2) ∗ rdCredInv γ

theorem heartbeat_commit_le_last [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (ps : PState)
    (m : Msg) {md : Bool} : m.ty = MsgType.heartbeat → m.dst = id → uint.Z ps.term ≤ uint.Z m.term →
    (m.term = ps.term → ps.role ≠ Role.leader) → ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id ps md -∗ isMessage γ m -∗
    ⌜uint.Z m.commit ≤ plogLastIndexZ ps.base ps.log⌝

theorem prop_collect [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (E : CoPset) (d : List w8) (Q : List
    EntryM → IProp GF) (L : List EntryM) (m : Nat) (e : EntryM) : ↑(raftN γ) ⊆ E → L[m]? = some e →
    ⊢ raftCommitInv γ -∗ propIs γ d Q -∗ isCommitted γ L -∗ entDataIs γ e (some d) ={E}=∗ ▷ ▷ □ Q
    (List.take m L)

theorem BootWf.wf {L : List EntryM} (H : BootWf L) : PlogWf base0 L

theorem app_no_conflict_below_commit [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (ps :
    PState) (m : Msg) {md : Bool} : m.ty = MsgType.app → m.dst = id → uint.Z ps.term ≤ uint.Z m.term
    → uint.Z ps.commit ≤ uint.Z m.index → ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id ps md -∗ isMessage γ m -∗ ⌜PlogMatches
    ps.base ps.log { term' := m.logterm, index' := m.index } → plogFindConflict ps.base ps.log
    m.entries = W64 0 ∨ uint.Z ps.commit < uint.Z (plogFindConflict ps.base ps.log m.entries)⌝

theorem entDataIs_list_agree [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) (o1 o2 :
    List (Option (List w8))) : ⊢ ([∗list] e;o ∈ l;o1, entDataIs γ e o) -∗ ([∗list] e;o ∈ l;o2,
    entDataIs γ e o) -∗ ⌜o1 = o2⌝

def BootWf (L : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ↑L.length < 2 ^ 61 ∧
    (∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM),
        L[k]? = some e →
          e.Term' = W64 1 ∧ uint.Z e.Index' = ↑k + 1 ∧ ¬Filler e.Type' e.Data' ∧ CCDecodes e.Type' e.Data') ∧
      (List.map (fun e => entKey e.Type' e.Data') L).Nodup

theorem allocClient_gen [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (E : CoPset) (cfg : GSet w64) (dyn : Option ((e :
    GooseExts) → DynCfg)) (ccOk : w32 → List w8 → Prop) (C : RaftNames → IProp GF) : allocClient E
    cfg dyn C ⊢ allocClientGen E cfg dyn ccOk [] C

theorem GMap.exists_fresh_nat {V : Type} (K : GMap Nat V) : ∃ k, K !! k = none

theorem propIsAt_propIs [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (γq : GName) (Q :
    List EntryM → IProp GF) : ⊢ propIsAt γ d γq -∗ savedPredOwn γq DFrac.discard Q -∗ propIs γ d Q

def propIsAt (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (γq : GName) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γd, d ↪[γ.reProps]□ (γq, γd))

theorem BootLogOk.wf {ps : List w64} {bootLog : List EntryM} (H : BootLogOk ps bootLog) (Hnd :
    ps.Nodup) : BootWf bootLog

theorem entDataIs_list_prefix [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l P : List EntryM) (o oP :
    List (Option (List w8))) (Hp : l <+: P) : ⊢ ([∗list] e;o ∈ l;o, entDataIs γ e o) -∗ ([∗list] e;o
    ∈ P;oP, entDataIs γ e o) -∗ ⌜o <+: oP⌝

def allocClientBoot [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (E : CoPset) (cfg : GSet w64) (ccOk : w32 → List w8 →
    Prop) (bootLog : List EntryM) (C : RaftNames → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ γ,
      ⌜γ.reCfg = cfg ∧ γ.reDyn = none ∧ γ.reCCOk = ccOk ∧ γ.reBoot = bootLog⌝ -∗
        isCommitted γ bootLog -∗
          rLog γ bootLog -∗
            ghostMapAuth γ.reFresh 1 (bootFresh bootLog) -∗ ghostMapAuth γ.reRdFresh 1 ∅ ={E}=∗ noopAu γ ∗ C γ)

theorem entsData_keys [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (L : List EntryM) : ([∗list] e ∈ L,
    entDataIs γ e (some (entKey e.Type' e.Data'))) ⊢ entsData γ L ∗ [∗list] e ∈ L, entData γ e

theorem boot_register [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (Lc : List EntryM) (γq : GName) (Ls
    : List EntryM) (R : GMap (List w8) PropRec) (F : GMap (List w8) Unit) : (List.map (fun e =>
    entKey e.Type' e.Data') Ls).Nodup → (∀ (e : EntryM), e ∈ Ls → ¬Filler e.Type' e.Data' ∧
    CCDecodes e.Type' e.Data' ∧ uint.Z e.Index' ≤ ↑Lc.length ∧ R !! entKey e.Type' e.Data' = none ∧
    F !! entKey e.Type' e.Data' = none) → ⊢ (savedPredOwn γq DFrac.discard fun x => iprop(True)) -∗
    ghostMapAuth γ.reProps 1 R -∗ ghostMapAuth γ.reFresh 1 F -∗ ([∗map] d ↦ p ∈ R, iprop(propSlot γ
    d p Lc ∗ propFresh γ d)) ==∗ ∃ R', ghostMapAuth γ.reProps 1 R' ∗ ghostMapAuth γ.reFresh 1
    (bootFreshFrom F Ls) ∗ ([∗map] d ↦ p ∈ R', iprop(propSlot γ d p Lc ∗ propFresh γ d)) ∗ ([∗list]
    e ∈ Ls, entDataIs γ e (some (entKey e.Type' e.Data'))) ∗ [∗list] e ∈ Ls, propIsAt γ (entKey
    e.Type' e.Data') γq

theorem BootWf.terms {L : List EntryM} (H : BootWf L) (e : EntryM) : e ∈ L → e.Term' = W64 1

def bootFreshFrom (F : GMap (List w8) Unit) (L : List EntryM) : GMap (List w8) Unit :=
  List.foldl (fun m e => Std.insert m (entKey e.Type' e.Data') ()) F L

theorem ownRaftGhost_alloc_gen [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (E : CoPset) (cfg ids : GSet w64) (dyn :
    Option ((e : GooseExts) → DynCfg)) (ccOk : w32 → List w8 → Prop) (C : RaftNames → IProp GF) :
    cfg ≠ ∅ → ¬W64 0 ∈ ids → ⊢ allocClient E cfg dyn C ={E}=∗ ∃ γ, ⌜γ.reCfg = cfg ∧ γ.reDyn = dyn ∧
    γ.reCCOk = ccOk ∧ γ.reNoXfer = false⌝ ∗ raftCommitInv γ ∗ isCommitted γ [] ∗ ([∗map] id ↦ _u ∈
    toMap ids, ownRaftGhost γ id initPState dyn.isSome) ∗ C γ ∗ rdCred γ (2 ^ 64 - 2) ∗ rdCredInv γ

theorem propIsAt_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (γq : GName) : Persistent (propIsAt γ d
    γq)

theorem rdCred_zero [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : ⊢ |==> rdCred γ 0

def BootLogOk (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  bootLog.length = ps.length ∧
    ↑bootLog.length < 2 ^ 61 ∧
      ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM),
        bootLog[k]? = some e →
          e.Term' = W64 1 ∧
            uint.Z e.Index' = ↑k + 1 ∧
              e.Type' = W32 1 ∧ ∃ m, ccDecodeV1 e.Data' = some m ∧ m.type = W32 0 ∧ ps[k]? = some m.nodeId

theorem app_recv_wf [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (ps : PState) (m : Msg) {md
    : Bool} : m.ty = MsgType.app → m.dst = id → ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id ps md -∗ isMessage γ m -∗
    ⌜PlogWf { term' := m.logterm, index' := m.index } m.entries ∧ uint.Z m.index + ↑m.entries.length
    + 1 < 2 ^ 64⌝

theorem initPState_eq : initPState = initPStateAt (W64 0) []

theorem rLog_committed [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (L : List EntryM) (E : CoPset) (HE
    : ↑(raftLogN γ) ⊆ E) : ⊢ raftCommitInv γ -∗ rLog γ L ={E}=∗ rLog γ L ∗ isCommitted γ L

def initPStateAt (t : w64) (L : List EntryM) : PState :=
  have __src := initPState;
  { term := t, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes, outbox := __src.outbox,
    base := __src.base, log := L, commit := W64 ↑L.length, matched := __src.matched, rd := __src.rd }

theorem ownRaftGhost_inv [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) : ⊢
    ownRaftGhost γ id s -∗ raftCommitInv γ

theorem prop_deposit [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (E : CoPset) (d : List w8) (Q : List
    EntryM → IProp GF) : ↑(raftN γ) ⊆ E → ⊢ raftCommitInv γ -∗ propIs γ d Q -∗ propAu1 γ d Q ={E}=∗
    propTk γ d

theorem ownRaftGhost_alloc_boot [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (E : CoPset) (cfg ids : GSet w64) (ccOk :
    w32 → List w8 → Prop) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (C : RaftNames → IProp GF) (ns nx
    : Bool) (sl : w64 → Option GName) : cfg ≠ ∅ → ¬W64 0 ∈ ids → cfg = listToSet ps → ps.Nodup →
    BootLogOk ps bootLog → ⊢ allocClientBoot E cfg ccOk bootLog C ={E}=∗ ∃ γ, ⌜γ.reCfg = cfg ∧
    γ.reDyn = none ∧ γ.reCCOk = ccOk ∧ γ.reBoot = bootLog ∧ γ.reTracked = some cfg ∧ γ.reNoSnap = ns
    ∧ γ.reNoXfer = nx ∧ γ.reSnapLoc = sl⌝ ∗ raftCommitInv γ ∗ isCommitted γ bootLog ∗ ([∗map] id ↦
    _u ∈ toMap ids, ownRaftGhost γ id (bootPState bootLog)) ∗ C γ ∗ rdCred γ (2 ^ 64 - 2) ∗
    rdCredInv γ

theorem ownRaftGhost_committed [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) {md
    : Bool} : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ ∃ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp⌝ ∗ isCommitted γ (List.take
    (uint.Z s.commit).toNat (fp ++ s.log))

theorem prop_register_at [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (E : CoPset) (d : List w8) (γq :
    GName) : ↑(raftN γ) ⊆ E → ⊢ raftCommitInv γ -∗ propFresh γ d ={E}=∗ propIsAt γ d γq

theorem BootWf.data {L : List EntryM} (H : BootWf L) (e : EntryM) : e ∈ L → ¬Filler e.Type' e.Data'
    ∧ CCDecodes e.Type' e.Data' ∧ uint.Z e.Index' ≤ ↑L.length

theorem ods_not_fresh [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) (ods : List
    (Option (List w8))) (R : GMap (List w8) PropRec) (d : List w8) (HRd : R !! d = none) : ⊢
    ([∗list] e;o ∈ l;ods, entDataIs γ e o) -∗ ghostMapAuth γ.reProps 1 R -∗ ⌜¬some d ∈ ods⌝

theorem propIsAt_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (γq : GName) : Timeless (propIsAt γ d γq)

theorem committed_data [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (E : CoPset) (l : List EntryM) :
    ↑(raftN γ) ⊆ E → ⊢ raftCommitInv γ -∗ isCommitted γ l ={E}=∗ ∃ ods, [∗list] e;o ∈ l;ods,
    entDataIs γ e o

theorem entsData_lookup [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) (ods : List
    (Option (List w8))) (m : Nat) (e : EntryM) (He : l[m]? = some e) : ⊢ ([∗list] e;o ∈ l;ods,
    entDataIs γ e o) -∗ ∃ o, ⌜ods[m]? = some o⌝ ∗ entDataIs γ e o

def allocClientGen [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (E : CoPset) (cfg : GSet w64) (dyn : Option ((e :
    GooseExts) → DynCfg)) (ccOk : w32 → List w8 → Prop) (L : List EntryM) (C : RaftNames → IProp GF)
    (nsN : Namespace := nroot.@"raft_commit") : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ γ,
      ⌜γ.reCfg = cfg ∧ γ.reDyn = dyn ∧ γ.reCCOk = ccOk ∧ γ.reBoot = L ∧ γ.reNs = nsN⌝ -∗
        isCommitted γ L -∗
          rLog γ L -∗
            ghostMapAuth γ.reFresh 1 (bootFresh L) -∗
              ghostMapAuth γ.reRdFresh 1 ∅ -∗
                (∃ γT,
                    (savedPredOwn γT DFrac.discard fun x => iprop(True)) ∗
                      [∗list] e ∈ L, propIsAt γ (entKey e.Type' e.Data') γT) ={E}=∗
                  noopAu γ ∗ C γ)

def bootPState (bootLog : List EntryM) : PState :=
  have __src := initPState;
  { term := W64 1, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes,
    outbox := __src.outbox, base := __src.base, log := bootLog, commit := W64 ↑bootLog.length, matched := __src.matched,
    rd := __src.rd }

theorem bootPState_eq (bootLog : List EntryM) : bootPState bootLog = initPStateAt (W64 1) bootLog

def allocClient [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (E : CoPset) (cfg : GSet w64) (dyn : Option ((e :
    GooseExts) → DynCfg)) (C : RaftNames → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ γ,
      ⌜γ.reCfg = cfg ∧ γ.reDyn = dyn⌝ -∗
        isCommitted γ [] -∗ rLog γ [] -∗ ghostMapAuth γ.reFresh 1 ∅ -∗ ghostMapAuth γ.reRdFresh 1 ∅ ={E}=∗ noopAu γ ∗ C γ)

theorem prop_register [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (E : CoPset) (d : List w8) (Q : List
    EntryM → IProp GF) : ↑(raftN γ) ⊆ E → ⊢ raftCommitInv γ -∗ propFresh γ d ={E}=∗ propIs γ d Q

def bootFresh (L : List EntryM) : GMap (List w8) Unit :=
  bootFreshFrom ∅ L

theorem ownRaftGhost_alloc_snap [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (E : CoPset) (cfg ids : GSet w64) (ccOk :
    w32 → List w8 → Prop) (sok : List BootEntry → List w8 → Prop) (C : RaftNames → IProp GF) : cfg ≠
    ∅ → ¬W64 0 ∈ ids → ⊢ allocClient E cfg none C ={E}=∗ ∃ γ, ⌜γ.reCfg = cfg ∧ γ.reDyn = none ∧
    γ.reCCOk = ccOk ∧ γ.reNoXfer = false ∧ γ.reNoSnap = false ∧ γ.reTracked = none ∧ γ.reSnapOkRaw =
    sok ∧ γ.reSnapLoc = fun x => none⌝ ∗ raftCommitInv γ ∗ isCommitted γ [] ∗ ([∗map] id ↦ _u ∈
    toMap ids, ownRaftGhost γ id initPState) ∗ C γ ∗ rdCred γ (2 ^ 64 - 2) ∗ rdCredInv γ
